inlines.v: IMPAL'PABLE, adjective [Latin in and palpo, to feel. [See Palpable.] Not to be felt; that cannot be perceived by the touch; as an impalpable powder, whose parts are so minute that they cannot be distinguished by the senses, particularly by feeling. 1. Not coarse or gross.
